dateAssessment: The working calendar is YAML’s May 14–16, 1749, independently anchored to May 14 by t03/t04 and extended by two completed overnights (t05/t19). The transcript-only assessment is matched. Session 103 closes with the simulacrum’s teleport in late afternoon May 14 (u3073–u3116); session 104 resumes about fifteen minutes later. Session 105 opens over the same jungle cave in the afternoon of May 16 (u0001–u0039), supporting the closing arrival watch. The second golem fight occurs before the second overnight in this extraction; the earlier rest-first plan was superseded (u2669–u2671, u2706–u2720, u2826–u3025, u3135, u3390–u3424). Exact start/end clocks for that rest remain approximate: its dusk-to-dawn placement is inferred before the post-return 06:00–06:30 clock. The separately registered session 107 is a May 18 narrative covering the beach landing, camp and pilgrimage hostel; it is an intervening episode, not a direct transcript handoff from session 106 to 108.
